desc:
🟢 WELCOME TO SLIME BOUNCE! 🍬

Bounce your way through a colourful world full of tricky challenges, satisfying shots, and adorable slimes!

🎯 MASTER THE BOUNCE
Aim carefully, launch yourself, and bounce through clever levels. Can you find the perfect angle and make it to the goal?

🌈 EXPLORE NEW WORLDS
Discover vibrant environments, tackle new obstacles, and see how far you can go!

✨ DISCOVER RARE SLIMES
Collect awesome slimes, find special variants, and show off your favourites.

🏆 BEAT EVERY LEVEL
Put your skills to the test, improve with every attempt, and become a bounce master!

🏀1v1 IN YOUR OWN SLIME COURT
1V1 players and friends in your server!

🛠️BUILD LEVELS FOR ALL PLAYERS  
Build your own levels and make it public for all players to play!

💚 Easy to pick up. Satisfying to master.

Ready to bounce? Jump in and start playing!

👍 Enjoying Slime Bounce? Leave a like and favourite the game to support us!
